title: SPE Chapter 05 - Autoload: PSR-4 Autoloading with Composer
description:
Chapter 05 of Simple PHP Engine - from one file to fourteen with PSR-4 autoloading.

This tutorial covers:
• PSR-4 namespace-to-directory mapping
• Composer autoloader integration
• Abstract Theme base class with concrete implementations
• Plugin directory structure (Model/View pairs)
• Fully qualified class name construction
• PHP 8.3 typed constants for namespace prefix
